catalysts.headline: PEPG shares continued higher the day after the DM1 data release, with heavy call-option volume reported by MarketBeat

PepGen's lead candidate (PGN-EDO51, Duchenne muscular dystrophy program) reported to have achieved the highest splicing correction yet seen in its mid-stage trial, per aggregator coverage; underlying primary source (company release / trial data) not independently located this session.

PepGen reported positive topline results from the 10 mg/kg multiple-ascending-dose (MAD) cohort of the ongoing Phase 2 FREEDOM2-DM1 study of PGN-EDODM1 in myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1), showing 46.5% mean splicing correction versus 6.8% for placebo; an independent data safety monitoring board had previously recommended advancing to the next (12.5 mg/kg) cohort with no protocol changes after reviewing available safety data
catalysts.impact: Stock surged; reported intraday/closing moves for Nov 10, 2026 range from approximately +92.9% (close of $4.61 vs. prior close $2.39) to as much as +126.6% to +146% at various points in the session (see conflicts)

catalysts.headline: PepGen reported topline results from the lowest-dose (5 mg/kg) MAD cohort of the Phase 2 FREEDOM2-DM1 study: PGN-EDODM1 generally well tolerated (no SAEs, no treatment-related discontinuations); mean splicing correction of 7.3% (n=6) vs. 6.8% placebo (n=2), with one outlier patient worsening to 70.8% pulling down the average (ex-outlier mean 22.9%, n=5); no meaningful improvement in 10-meter walk/run test or handgrip strength at this dose; vHOT (video hand-opening time) showed a positive trend in the treated group vs. worsening in placebo, both returning to baseline by Week 16

conflicts: MAJOR UNRESOLVED CONFLICT: the task states PEPG was 'up +122.9% today' on 2026-11-11, attributed to the PGN-EDO51 Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) program. However, every dated source found in this session attributes the large single-day move (ranging from ~92.9% to as much as ~126.6%-146% depending on the exact snapshot) to Nov 10, 2026, and to Phase 2 FREEDOM2-DM1 topline data for PGN-EDODM1 in myotonic dystrophy (DM1) -- a different drug candidate and a different disease indication than DMD/PGN-EDO51. Nov 11, 2026 readings found (MarketBeat: +20.7% to $5.56; Yahoo-derived: +16.95%) are much smaller than +122.9% and are described as a continuation/options-flow story, not a fresh catalyst. This may reflect either (a) a one-day lag between when the news broke and when the task's data snapshot was taken, or (b) the task's note conflating the DM1 readout with the DMD program; it was not possible to reconcile definitively from available sources, so both the task's figure and the sourced figures are preserved here rather than silently picking one.
Market cap figures found (~$75M, ~$160.68M, ~$170.38M) are mutually inconsistent and undated relative to the Nov 10-11 price spike, so none is reported as a current fundamentals figure.

FY2025 EPS could not be reconciled: a derived sum-of-quarters net loss of ~$89.7M conflicts with one third-party site's -$2.12 EPS figure once combined with a weighted-average share count that itself more than doubled intra-year; no figure is reported as confirmed.
notes: The task's framing names the catalyst as the 'PGN-EDO51, Duchenne muscular dystrophy program,' but the dated news located in this session points instead to PGN-EDODM1 / myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1) FREEDOM2-DM1 trial data as the actual driver of the Nov 10-11, 2026 stock move. This discrepancy should be verified against PepGen's own investor-relations site or SEC 8-K before publishing, since it affects which drug program and indication the catalyst should be attributed to.
